title: Jhoan Duran faces marathon of outings with the Philadelphia Phillies
seoTitle: Jhoan Duran faces marathon of outings with the Phillies
subtitle: The closer had an intense stretch of games as Philadelphia seeks to clinch a playoff spot.
excerpt: With three saves in four days, Jhoan Duran's arm durability becomes a decisive factor for the Philadelphia Phillies' postseason hopes.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Philadelphia Phillies' closer Jhoan Duran is drawing major attention due to his intense workload in the final stretch of the season. The right‑handed pitcher appeared in four games over the past week, tallying three save‑outs in just four days. This concentrated effort comes as the team pushes to secure a postseason berth in baseball.

Duran's recent pitching stretch

Duran endured a demanding stretch, as reported by The Good Phight. On Sunday, the pitcher needed 33 pitches to lock down a save for his team. He took the mound again on Monday in another save situation, using only 10 pitches. After a rest day on Tuesday, he closed out the game on Wednesday, totaling 61 pitches across three appearances over a four‑day span.

Injury history and innings count

The right‑hander missed time earlier this season due to a strain in his oblique muscle. That temporary absence, however, may now be benefiting him at this point in the campaign. Duran has logged just 45.1 innings this season, a figure well below the 70 innings he recorded the previous year. The total also trails his 2025 pace, when he had amassed 55 innings by August 19.

Fastball velocity and bullpen wear

So far, the pitcher shows no signs of physical wear in his outings. On the contrary, his fastball velocity has risen as the season has progressed. Meanwhile, the rest of the Phillies’ bullpen is already feeling the effects of using relievers in rapid succession with limited recovery time. With about a month left in the regular season and the club playing tightly contested games, Duran is likely to remain heavily utilized.

The player's role in fantasy leagues

Beyond his real‑world impact on the Phillies’ October playoff push, Duran’s performance directly influences virtual baseball leagues. He is viewed as a top‑tier closer for fantasy participants. The durability of his arm through September and October will be one of the key factors for Philadelphia’s playoff aspirations.

With information from RotoBaller, Northeast Times.
